caption: SPY performance sorted by lagged SOX/SPY relative strength 6-month-momentum quartile: Sharpe (left) and annualized return (right). The pattern is hump-shaped, NOT monotonic — Q2 (Sharpe 1.22) and Q3 (1.06) are strongest while the extreme-weak Q1 is negative (-0.05). This is descriptive context, not the tradable rule, and it does not by itself validate a clean procyclical gradient.
